content.value: You want to establish an account with an on-line service, for which you need to choose a password. 'They require that your password contain at least eight symbols, including at least two different letters, at least two digits, and at least one special symbol. Generate a regular expression that accepts exactly the string that satisfy these requirements, which you can use to test your password choice for validity. For simplicity, assume that the set of possible symbols is $\{ a , b , c , d , 0 , 1 , \# , \$ \ S \}$ , of which a, b, c and d are letters, 0 and 1 are digits, and # and \$ are special symbols.
